verdicts.proof: Old: _completed flag payment_screen.dart:103, checked in _recoverPaymentOnResume :215/:249 and _onPaymentSuccess :1329-1330; _doPayment :913 also refuses when _completed. The v2 view PaymentViewV2 is built inside the same State (payment_screen.dart:1520-1544) and its only pay entry is onPay: _doPayment (:1543, PayDockV2 v2/pay_dock_v2.dart:89/126). All success paths (payment_screen.dart:1205,1212,1267,1325; payment_screen_changes.dart:203,214,247; payment_screen_problems.dart:50,366) are shared State methods. Lifecycle observer is registered in initState for both looks.

PaymentScreen sets paymentScreenActiveProvider in initState post-frame (payment_screen.dart:167-169) and clears it in dispose for both looks. Old pills: shell_fab_layer.dart:52-54 onPaymentScreen used for cart :65, booking :75, route :84, SOS :94, docs :113. v2 strips: _v2Strips shell_fab_layer.dart:255-257 with the same onPaymentScreen in cart :264, booking :266, route :269, SOS :276, docs :286. The v2-only AI button is also hidden: app_shell_v2.dart:167 fabHidden includes paymentScreenActiveProvider, used at :264 MgAiFab(hidden: fabHidden). /payment and /sos-payment are shell routes (router.dart:418, :500).

Documents/e-mail are issued only in _onPaymentSuccess (payment_screen.dart:1357-1361 new booking, :1422-1426 resumed booking; extension in payment_screen_changes.dart:174-176). Card result: _serverConfirmed (:1225-1243) must return true, otherwise _goPending (:1213-1216); Processing intents go through _awaitProcessingConfirmation (:1249-1272) with the same rule. None of this is in the v2 files; v2 only calls onPay: _doPayment (payment_screen.dart:1543).

Old: PaymentCountdown(timeRemaining) widgets/payment_header_widgets.dart:77-104 shown at payment_screen.dart:1560 in every flow. v2: PayCountdownChipV2 (v2/countdown_chip_v2.dart:44-58) gets the same _timeRemaining/_expired/_processing (payment_screen.dart:1536-1539) and is always put in the header (v2/payment_view_v2.dart:98-109); in the last 5 minutes it turns amber with 'dokonči platbu' (lastMinutes payment_screen.dart:1540), adds 'termín ti zatím držíme' for booking flows. Old PriceSummaryCard (booking/widgets/price_summary.dart:46-149; release 70a94933 had the same rows with 'vel. X'): extras with size '(vel. XL)' :54-55, delivery and return with the km detail '(X km × 40 + 1 000)' :63-74 via _deliveryLabel :157-165, and ONE total that already includes bundled add-ons (_totalWithUpsell :27, :140). v2 PayBreakdownV2 (v2/pay_receipt_v2.dart:103-118) -> BookingPriceV2 (booking/v2/sections/price_v2.dart:70-110): same lines and same providers (effectiveExtrasProvider, priceBreakdownProvider; payment_screen.dart:1525-1528) BUT extras show only extraLabel without the size (:72-73; grep finds no sizeAbbr/extraSizeLabel in price_v2.dart), delivery/return show plain 'Přistavení'/return label without the km breakdown (:74-75), and when an e-shop add-on is bundled the big dark 'Celkem' box shows bd.total WITHOUT the add-on (:104-106) while a second small card below shows the real total (pay_receipt_v2.dart:108-116). So before paying the customer can no longer check the gear sizes or the delivery km, and with a bundled add-on the headline total is not the amount charged.
verdicts.fix_idea: In BookingPriceV2 (v2-only file) append the old size suffix to the extras label (' (${tr.tr('sizeAbbr')} ${extraSizeLabel(tr.tr, e.size!)})' when e.size != null) and reuse the old _deliveryLabel km text for delivery/return rows; on the payment page pass the bundled add-on total into the dark total box (or render the add-on rows inside the same card before the total) so the headline total equals breakdown.total + upsell, as in the old card.
